decks.notes: The deck focuses on assembling UrzaTron (Urza's Mine, Urza's Tower, Urza's Power Plant) to generate large amounts of mana quickly. It utilizes cards like Expedition Map and Sylvan Scrying to find the Tron lands efficiently. The deck includes powerful control elements like Oblivion Stone and Karn, the Great Creator to control the board and disrupt opponent's strategies. Additionally, it incorporates threats like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Wurmcoil Engine to quickly close out games once the Tron lands are assembled. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional value and versatility to the deck.

The deck focuses on using powerful control cards like Bloodchief's Thirst and Damnation to dominate the battlefield. It also utilizes cards like Relic of Progenitus and March of Wretched Sorrow to disrupt opponents' strategies by removing cards from their graveyard. The inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator allows for searching for artifacts to further control the game. The key strategy revolves around generating mana with cards like Cabal Coffers and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth to cast large threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and utilize powerful spells like Demolition Field to control the board.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining card advantage. The deck utilizes a combination of removal spells like Fatal Push and Bloodchief's Thirst, along with graveyard hate from cards like Relic of Progenitus. The win condition is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Karn, the Great Creator. The deck also includes utility lands like Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Cabal Coffers to generate mana and cards like March of Wretched Sorrow for added control.

This deck utilizes a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and put into play at instant speed using cards like Chord of Calling and Collected Company. By combining sacrifice outlets like Viscera Seer and Woe Strider with creatures like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Cauldron Familiar, the deck can generate value and create combos to control the board and outvalue opponents. The deck also includes disruptive creatures like Skyclave Apparition and Ranger-Captain of Eos to interact with opponents' strategies and solidify its own game plan.

This deck focuses on aggressive play by utilizing the Death's Shadow archetype to quickly get opponents to low life totals. The key strategy involves casting Death's Shadow early on by manipulating your own life total with cards like Thoughtseize and Mishra's Bauble. By controlling the game with disruption spells like Lightning Bolt and Drown in the Loch, while also generating card advantage with Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Expressive Iteration, this deck aims to outpace opponents and secure victories through dealing massive amounts of damage in a short amount of time.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays and disruption, utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt opponents' strategies while applying pressure with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to deal with threats. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice allows for recurring threats and card advantage. The deck aims to close out games quickly by overwhelming opponents with a combination of aggression and disruption.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to quickly ramp up mana production and cast powerful Eldrazi creatures. The deck focuses on control elements such as Thought-Knot Seer and Matter Reshaper to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also utilizing Karn, the Great Creator to further control the board and shut down opposing strategies. Additionally, cards like Chalice of the Void and Relic of Progenitus provide additional disruption and graveyard hate to help secure victory. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats and control elements.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a variety of counter spells and removal cards to disrupt your opponent's strategy. It also utilizes powerful cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Shark Typhoon to generate advantage and tempo. The inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion adds additional value and synergy to the deck. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistency in casting spells and accessing the necessary colors of mana. Overall, the deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver opponents through well-timed plays and resource management.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions and resources while using powerful creatures and spells like Omnath and Emrakul to close out the game quickly. It utilizes a variety of lands and spells to maintain board control and disrupt the opponent's strategies. The deck also includes a mix of removal spells and counterspells to handle threats efficiently. Additionally, the deck incorporates powerful enchantments and support cards to further enhance its control abilities and provide additional win conditions.

The primary focus of this deck is to establish and maintain control over the game through various means such as disruption, removal, and resource denial. By utilizing cards like Fatal Push, Bloodchief's Thirst, and Damnation, the deck aims to keep the opponent's board clear while also leveraging powerful planeswalkers like Karn, the Great Creator and creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to generate advantage. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Relic of Progenitus and Field of Ruin to disrupt the opponent's game plan and ensure that the Mono Black Control player can dictate the pace of the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing cheap and aggressive spells to quickly put pressure on the opponent, while also disrupting their game plan with counterspells. Mishra's Bauble and Thought Scour provide card advantage and help fuel Delirium for cards like Unholy Heat. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler are efficient threats that can quickly close out games if left unanswered. The deck has a strong mana base to support its color requirements and includes cantrips like Expressive Iteration and Consider to filter through the deck and find key cards.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent by utilizing low-cost spells and efficient creatures that can quickly close out the game. The deck focuses on card selection and efficiency, using cards like Expressive Iteration and Sleight of Hand to dig for threats and answers. The deck also aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with Counterspells and removal spells like Unholy Heat. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler are the main threats that can deal damage quickly and be difficult to deal with.

This deck focuses on control through a mix of powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, along with removal spells like Solitude and Prismatic Ending. The main win condition is The One Ring, which can generate a lot of value and card advantage. The deck also includes a variety of lands to ensure color fixing and flexibility in casting spells. Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines provides a powerful anthem effect, boosting the team's power and toughness for a quick finish. Overall, the deck aims to dominate the board and outvalue the opponent.

The deck focuses on aggressively dealing damage to the opponent through burn spells and efficient creatures. It aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero with a combination of direct damage spells like Lava Spike, Lightning Bolt, and Skullcrack, as well as creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear. The deck also includes cards like Searing Blaze and Boros Charm to control the board and protect its own creatures. The mana base is designed to consistently provide access to the necessary colors to cast spells and maintain pressure on the opponent.
